_comment: Declared exceptions for scripts/check-backend-functions.mjs. Every entry states why the endpoint's source is not where you would expect it. Prefer promoting source into netlify/functions/ or supabase/functions/ over adding an entry here.
_migrationBackupIsLoadBearing: IMPORTANT: .migration-backup/ is NOT dead weight. It holds the only in-repo source for the functions declared below. It is excluded from every other guard, so a routine dead-code sweep will delete it - one nearly did on 2026-08-17. Do not remove it without first promoting these functions into supabase/functions/.

supabaseBackupOnly.appeal-generator: Deployed to Supabase out-of-band; .migration-backup/supabase/functions/appeal-generator is the authoritative repo record. Powers the AI appeals generator.
supabaseBackupOnly.civic-copilot: Deployed to Supabase out-of-band; backup tree is the authoritative repo record. Powers the AIChatWidget.
supabaseBackupOnly.airnow-proxy: Deployed to Supabase out-of-band; backup tree is the authoritative repo record. Powers real-time AQI on /environment/air.
supabaseBackupOnly.arcgis-proxy: Deployed to Supabase out-of-band; backup tree is the authoritative repo record. Powers ArcGIS FeatureServer reads behind the civic datasets.
supabaseBackupOnly.cdc-proxy: Deployed to Supabase out-of-band; backup tree is the authoritative repo record. Powers CDC data reads.
supabaseBackupOnly.gtfs-rt-proxy: Deployed to Supabase out-of-band; backup tree is the authoritative repo record. Powers realtime transit feeds.
supabaseBackupOnly.npi-proxy: Deployed to Supabase out-of-band; backup tree is the authoritative repo record. Powers NPPES provider search.

_netlifyNote: Empty by design. chat-mistral was promoted from .migration-backup/netlify/functions/ into netlify/functions/ on 2026-08-17 so Netlify actually deploys it; its catch block was malformed and leaked err.message to the client, and was fixed in the same change. Every Netlify endpoint the app calls now has deployable source.
